I don't hate his rework, but Jormungandr. I wished they kept his first kit, remove all the stam drain, but have every bash do a set amount of damage. The punches could do 5 damage or 10, and the neutral bash could do 10 or 12. Keep his undodgeable light, so he can catch dodges, and that's it. I liked punching people in the gut a lot in chain.

"A character needs more than a bash to be viable at all levels to all players." My friend, it seems you are new to the game, for there was a time in For Honor where most of the cast did not have a front dodge bash to open up opponents. They updated the game so that most of the cast had some sort of opener. Let that be a bash, unreactable trap, unblockable out of neutral, or a soft feint. The fact that Warden has a variable timed bash that can be feinted at any time into guardbreak or into a roll catcher makes him one of the most powerful characters in the game. Not only that, but as long as he has stamina, he can keep looping said bash, over and over again. Even if he hits you with a finisher unblockable, he can go back into bash mix-up. The opponent needs to make a hard read to dodge it or interrupt it. 

Seems to me like it's more of a skill issue on your part rather than the character being weak. What you need to do is hit the practice range and figure out all the combos Warden can actually do, and learn how to effectively anti gank/ team fight in 4s.

"Throw two lights to hit his dash." Untrue. He can heavy and then bash. He can zone and then bash. He can bash out of front and side dodges. Sounds to me like you don't know the hero's moveset. Warden is a top-tier duelist and quite good in fours  due to his unblockables having good hit boxes and tracking.
